narration.text: Still struggling to make video from text for free?
At number 5, Pictory quickly turns articles or scripts into video, fully automated. You can add captions and brand your content, perfect for social media.
Number 4 is Synthesys. This tool offers realistic AI avatars and supports multiple languages. It also provides diverse voice options to make your videos engaging.
Coming in at number 3, HeyGen creates lifelike avatars and allows for custom branding. It generates videos incredibly fast, saving you valuable time.
Number 2, InVideo AI, provides advanced editing features. It automatically adds B-roll, music, and voiceovers, making professional video creation simple.
Our top pick, Descript, lets you edit video like text. Its powerful AI features simplify the entire process, making complex edits feel effortless.
Descript's ability to edit video by editing text is truly groundbreaking. Which text to video tool do you think is the best?

description: Discover the top 5 AI tools that transform your text into engaging videos. From automated content creation to realistic avatars and advanced editing, these tools make video production easy and accessible. Create stunning videos without complex software.
